title: 2600: The Hacker Quarterly, Autumn 2026

description.main: The Autumn 2026 issue of 2600, Volume 43 Number 3, opening with a report on HOPE 26 and running pieces on vibe coding, AI ethics, steganography, machine code, rootkits and EXIF metadata alongside the standing columns and part three of the Dr. Hook serial.
description.extended:
The Autumn 2026 issue, the first since HOPE 26, with four pieces on artificial intelligence alongside the usual technical features.

It opens with "HOPE Marches On." The AI pieces are "Vibe Coding: Garbage In, Garbage Out," "The Zero of AI," "Systemic AI Ethical Zero-Day Investigation (Gemini/Perplexity)" and "What I Learned by Feeding Nine Years of My Own Chat Messages Into an AI." The technical pieces include "Writing Software in Machine Code From Scratch," "Mao - A Protracted People's Rootkit" and "Skimmin' Sudo." It also prints "How to Use Steganography to Take Advantage of Cloud Storage" and "EXIF Deceit: Using ExifTool to Inspect, Strip, and Falsify Location Metadata." "A Twitter Origin Story and Why I Am Singing the Social Media Blues" is among the other features. The four standing columns appear as usual, along with a review of The Long History of the Future and "Dr. Hook vs. God's Eye Part Three: The Heart Beneath the Code."

Released 7 October 2026, two months after HOPE 26, in the forty-third year of continuous publication.

notes: Released 7 October 2026. Acquired new. Cover: a toll plaza at dusk under a blue "Change Ahead" sign, with an "AGI Keep Right" sign, an E-ZPass lane and the Lower Manhattan skyline behind; no cover artist credit found on the store page, the release note or 2600.com (the cover gallery stops at Spring 2013). Contents also include Letters and Marketplace. HOPE 26 ran 14-16 August 2026 at the New Yorker Hotel, New York.
